script_text: Stop everything, Capricorn. Pluto in Aquarius is forming a powerful trine to natal Saturn, your ruling planet, awakening deep transformation in your 1st House of Self. This is not a day to stay small. Venus in soft sextile to your 10th House of Career opens a surprising door for love to bloom through professional connections — someone in authority may see you differently today. Financially, Mercury's conjunction with Jupiter in your 2nd House of Money means a conversation about value, salary, or investment could land in your favor. Watch for a surprise blessing disguised as a last-minute meeting you almost canceled. Saturn reminds you that your patience, grounded earth wisdom, has been building toward something real. Do not ignore a gut feeling about money or love this evening. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
